title: Context != Context: One window, many lifecycles (AI Native DevCon, Nov 2026)
summary:
https://youtu.be/NxypyNu1944

Workflow instructions, coding conventions, tickets, wiki pages, and observability data all end up in the same context window, and we call all of it "context." To the model, it's tokens shaping the next prediction. For the people who write, maintain, and rely on context, these tokens differ a lot in where they come from, how much authority they carry, and how they can go wrong. Some are deliberately authored and quality assured. Others emerge as a byproduct of work and are dynamically retrieved and reconciled from organizational systems.

This talk discusses how these differences change the ways that each kind is created, checked, and delivered to the agent, and that treating them alike can lead to using unsuitable tools and processes. You will leave with a clearer idea of the types of context you have available for your coding agents, and the techniques to maintain and distribute them.
ja_summary:
AI開発において、指示書やコード規約、チケット、Wiki、観測データといった多様な「コンテキスト」は、AIにとっては単なるトークン。
しかし、人間にとっては、生成元や信頼度、誤りの可能性が大きく異なり、それぞれ適切な管理方法が必要。
本稿は、AIエージェントに渡すコンテキストの種類と、それぞれの管理・配布テクニックを解説する。

## ⚖️ はじめに

ja_summary:

・判断モデルを活用することで、効率的な情報抽出を可能にする新しいアプローチ。

title: NTTデータと日立　FDEで人月脱却へ
source: 日経クロステック 総合
